scenario: Debating the pros and cons of remote work
frequency_note: words ranked ~1500–3000 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Ezali na bosembo mingi na makambo ya komonisa yango.
Ezali koyokana mikapo mibale; ekomela na nzela ya liboso to na mokolo.
Na mokolo oyo eleki 'mbotama'.
Ezali kosalema bosembo.
Na nzela ya liboso eleki 'kasi' to 'kasi'.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: One clear benefit of remote work is that it can increase your productivity, don't you think?
dialogue.translation: Mbongo moko ya lisolo ya kozala na mokolo ezali kozonga bosembo na yango, ozali koyeba?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That's true for some people. However, I've noticed several issues with it.
dialogue.translation: Ezali solo na bato moko. Kasi, nakomi bankati mibongo na yango.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: What kind of issues? I think most problems are similar to those you'd face in an office.
dialogue.translation: Mibongo nini? Nakoki koloba ete mibongo mingi ezali mibongo moko na yango ozali koyokana na bureau.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Well, remote work may require a lot of self-discipline. If you don't manage your time well, you'll likely fall behind.
dialogue.translation: Eh, lisolo ya kozala na mokolo ekoki kozua bokasi mingi. Soki ozali kozala na bokasi na ntango na yo, ozali na bosembo kozala na mbala.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I see your point. But companies should provide proper training and tools to help employees, though.
dialogue.translation: Nakoki koyeba mokolo na yo. Kasi, mikakatiko ekoki kopesa lisolo ya solo mpe mikakatiko ya kozua basaleli, kasi.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, they should. Therefore, it's not just about the employee's effort; the employer also has a role.
dialogue.translation: Eh, bango ekoki. Kasi, ezali te na bosembo ya basaleli; moyibi azali na bokasi.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Absolutely. And I believe the flexibility remote work offers is a huge benefit that many people value.
dialogue.translation: Solo. Mpe nakoki koloba ete kozala na mokolo ezali mbongo moko ya kozala na bosembo ya kozala na bato mingi.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I agree, as long as we address the issues we mentioned. Then it can work well for everyone.
dialogue.translation: Nakoki koyeba, soki tokoki koyokana mibongo oyo tokolaki. Kasi ekoki kozala na bosembo ya bato nionso.

key_phrases.translation: mibongo moko na yango ozali koyokana
kozala na bokasi na ntango na yo

scenario: Discussing a complex ethical dilemma
frequency_note: words ranked ~1500–3000 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Bosalemi na gerundio: tómba kóla yango.
Na kati ya contexte oyo, ezali lisusu kombo to ndakisa ya mambu oyo tozalaki kóla.
Ezali kozonga mpo na kopesa ndakisa mpo na bandimi ya mambu mibili to mizalani.
Na lisusu ezali kobomana: kozala na mbotama = kozala na mbotama.
Na ntala ezali kobomana na gerundio: komona kóla yango.
Ezali kozala na lokuta to gerundio, kasi te na lokuta oyo ezali na verba oyo ezali kobundana.
Ezali kozala na ntoma to na ntoma.
Ezali koluka te kosala eloko to kopesa eloko.
Na ntala ezali kosala na gerundio: kozala na kóla yango.
Ezali na ndakisa ya bosangani, kasi ezali na ntala na kati ya mambu oyo ezali na bosangani.
Ezali kozala ya makasi to ya makasi (mbongo ya kati ya bato, ya salu, etc.).
Na nzela ya mobu ezali koloba 'kasi' to 'kasi'. Boye koluka na konzo ya 'though'.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: We need to decide whether to expose the company's mistake, even though it could cause a huge scandal.
dialogue.translation: Tokoki kozonga mpo na kopesa ndakisa mpo na komona mpo na koluka yango, kasi ezali kozala na kombo ya mbotama ya makasi.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That's a serious ethical concern. But first, let's consider the outcome of each possible choice.
dialogue.translation: Ezali mbotama ya ntoma ya makasi. Kasi ntango ya mona, tokoki komona bosangani ya bandimi ya mambu oyo tokoki kozala na yango.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: If we ignore it, we might avoid immediate problems, but the long-term damage to our reputation could be worse.
dialogue.translation: Soki tokoluka yango, tokoki tómba mabotama oyo ezali na ntango ya mokolo moko, kasi bosangani ya ntango ya mokolo moko ezali kozala mawa.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: True. Yet the pressure from the board to keep this quiet is intense. They don't want any legal trouble, despite the risk.
dialogue.translation: Yaソロ. Kasi mbongo oyo ezali kosala mpo na kotambola ezali ya makasi. Basaleli te mpo na kozala na mbotama ya ntoma, malgré bosangani.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I understand, but our decision should not involve hiding facts that affect public safety. That would be wrong.
dialogue.translation: Nazali komona, kasi kozanga na biso ezali kozala te kozala na mambu oyo ezali kozala na bosangani ya bato. Ezali kozala mawa.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I agree. Still, we need to think about the employees who might lose their jobs if we go public. It's a tough dilemma.
dialogue.translation: Nazali kozanga. Kasi tokoki komona mpo na basaleli oyo tokoki koluka salu na bango soki tokoki kozala na bango. Ezali mbotama ya makasi.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Exactly. But supporting the right cause sometimes means accepting some collateral damage. We can't just please everyone, though.
dialogue.translation: Yaソロ. Kasi kozala na kombo ya solo ezali kozala na bosangani ya mbotama. Tokoki te kozala na bango nyonso, kasi.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: You're right. Let's present both sides to the board and let them decide, but we'll make sure our recommendation is clear.
dialogue.translation: Ozali na solo. Tokoki kopesa bandimi mibili na basaleli mpo na bango kozanga, kasi tokoki kobima mpo na kopesa biso ndakisa ya solo.

scenario: Analyzing the impact of social media on society

vocabulary.note: Ezali na kosalela ete moke mwa influence to change na nkombo ya moke mwa ye.
Ezali na kosalela ete moke mwa ndenge bato basali.
Bande ya bato bazali na mawa moke mpe bazali kobatela yango.
Mewa ya biloko oyo ebimisami, mbala noki na ndakisa ya numérique.
Mewa to résultat ya moke mwa ye.
Na kosalela ete moke mwa ye oyo ezali na nguya to ezali na elongo.
Oyo ezali na nguya mingi ete ekoki kosala.
Oyo ekoki kobengamela to komonana mingi.
Oyo ezali malamu to ezali na elongo.
Mbala moke mpe kaka moke te.
Oyo ezali na kosalela ete moke mwa société to moke mwa ndenge bato basali na bande.
Ezali na kosalela ete moke mwa ye oyo ezali na kontra na moke mwa ye.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Do you think social media has a positive effect on our community?
dialogue.translation: Oyebi ete réseaus sociaux ezali na effet malamu na communauté ya biso?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: It can, especially when people share useful information, but it also affects our behavior in several ways.
dialogue.translation: Ezali na kosala, surtout tango bato bazali kopesa biloko oyo ezali na elongo, kasi ezali mpe na effet na ndenge ya biso ya kosala na bande na mawa moke.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: And have you seen the data that shows how much time people spend on these platforms?
dialogue.translation: Mpe oyebi mewa oyo ezali kolakisa ete bato bazali kosala ntango mingi na plateforme oyo?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, it's obvious that we're more connected than ever, though sometimes that connection feels superficial.
dialogue.translation: Eh, ezali monene ete biso tuzali na connexion mingi, kasi mbala moke ezali na elongo te.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: So, do you think the overall effect is likely to be more harmful than helpful?
dialogue.translation: Eh, oyebi ete effet ya ntango nyonso ekoki kozala na elongo mingi koleka na elongo?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I'm not sure. It depends on how we use it. For example, it can be a great tool for organizing social movements.
dialogue.translation: Nalingi kozala na elongo te. Ezali na kosalela ete moke mwa ndenge biso tuzali kosala. Na ndakisa, ezali na kosala na mawa moke na kosala mouvement social.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: But it also spreads misinformation quickly, which can affect public opinion in a negative way.
dialogue.translation: Kasi ezali mpe na kosala na mawa moke na kosala na elongo te, oyo ekoki kozala na effet na elongo te na opinion ya bato.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Exactly. So we need to be critical and not just accept everything we see. That's the key, though.
dialogue.translation: Ezali na elongo. Biso tuzali na kosala na elongo mpe kozala na elongo te na moke mwa ye oyo biso tuzali kobenga. Ezali na elongo, kasi.

key_phrases.translation: kozala na effet na ndenge ya kosala
kozala na kosala na elongo te

vocabulary.note: Mboyo ya kobondela to plan ya kobondela.
Mbongo oyo ekokani na yango mpo na mosala moko.

Ezali kosalema na ntina; ezali kosalema mingi mpo na baninga to mibe.
Ezali kosalema lélo; ezali na ntina.
Ezali kosalema mpo na kobakisa to kozala na kati ya groupe moko.
Ezali kobakisa mpo na kosala mabe to kozala na mabe.
Ezali kobakisa mpo na kosala bosó to kozala na bosó.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Good morning, everyone. I'm here to present our proposal for the new marketing campaign.
dialogue.translation: Mbote na bino nyonso. Nazali awa mpo na kopesa mboyo na biso mpo na kampani mosala ya kosala makasi ya sika.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Thanks. We have a limited budget, so we need to ensure every dollar counts.
dialogue.translation: Matondo. Tokoki kozala na mbongo moke, mpo ete tokoki kobongisa ete mbongo nyonso ekoyaka.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Absolutely. Our strategy focuses on digital ads to reach our target audience more effectively.
dialogue.translation: Na bosémí. Stratégie na biso ezali kozala na makasi mpo na kosala makasi mpo na kotambola bato oyo tokoki kobenga na bosémí.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: But how can we achieve significant growth with such a small budget?
dialogue.translation: Kasi, ndenge nini tokoki kotambola makasi mingi na mbongo moke?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Although the budget is small, we can leverage social media, which is popular among our potential clients.
dialogue.translation: Ata mbongo ezali moke, tokoki kosala makasi na réso mibeko, oyo ezali makasi na kati ya baninga na biso oyo tokoki kozala na ntina.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That sounds promising. What about our current campaigns? Should we replace them?
dialogue.translation: Ezali kobakisa bosó. Ndenge nini ezali na kampani na biso oyo ezali na ntina? Tokoki kozala na kampani mosala mosala?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: We'll adjust them, not replace. Therefore, we can maintain brand consistency while testing new ideas.
dialogue.translation: Tokoki kozala na kampani mosala, kasi tokoki kozala na kampani mosala. Mpo ete, tokoki kozala na makasi ya makasi na bosémí na kosala makasi mpo na kosala makasi mibeko.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Alright, I see the potential. Let's discuss this further in our next meeting.
dialogue.translation: Eh, nazali mona makasi. Tokoki kosala makasi mingi na mokolo mosala na biso.

key_phrases.translation: kozala na makasi ya makasi na bosémí

Motuna ya kozala na ntina; na lokola: reduced.

Ezali koyeba ntango to mabe.

vocabulary.translation: na nzela ya, na nzela ya
vocabulary.note: Ezali koyeba nzela to nzela ya kosala likambo.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I've been feeling a lot of stress lately, but I haven't talked to anyone about it.
dialogue.translation: Nazali na mabé ya esengo mingi na nsuka, kasi nalobaki na moto na yango te.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: It's important to be open about these things. I found that talking to a friend really helps.
dialogue.translation: Ezali ya ntina kozala liboso na bangogo oyo. Nalobi na moninga na yango, ezali kosala bokasi.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I know, but I don't want to burden anyone. I feel I should handle it alone.
dialogue.translation: Nazali koyeba, kasi naleyi kobebisa moto te. Nazali komona boye nazali kosala yango na bosoto.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: You're not alone, though. Asking for support is a sign of strength, not weakness.
dialogue.translation: Ozali na bosoto te, kasi. Kolinga bokasi ezali elongo ya mibeli, te ya mabe.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That's true. Do you have any advice on how to reduce this feeling of being overwhelmed?
dialogue.translation: Ezali solo. Oyebi molongo oyo ezali kosala bokasi na nzela ya kobimisa komona oyo ya kozala na mabé ya esengo?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, since exercise works well for me, I try to walk every day. It helps improve my mood.
dialogue.translation: Eh, tango likambo ya kozala na esengo ezali kosala bokasi na ngai, nazali koyoka kozala na mokolo moko na mokolo moko. Ezali kosala bokasi na esengo na ngai.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I've heard that, but I never seem to find the time. Maybe I can go through a simple routine at home.
dialogue.translation: Nazali koyeba yango, kasi nazali koyoka ntango te. Mbala mosusu nazali koyoka kozala na bangogo ya moke na ndako.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That's a good start. Just remember, you don't have to face this alone, and there's always support available.
dialogue.translation: Ezali mbongwana ya moke. Koyeba, ozali na bosoto te, mpe bokasi ezali na elongo na yo.

scenario: Talking about urban vs rural living
frequency_note: words ranked ~1500–3000 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Ezali kotɛka na loba ya mobimba mpo na kosalela contrast

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: After living in the city for five years, I'm seriously thinking about moving outside the urban area.
dialogue.translation: Simá ná kosalaka mokolo misano na ville, nazali kokɔmba mpenza na kobimisa ndenge na kati ya ville.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Really? I find cities quite convenient — you have access to everything you need within a short walk.
dialogue.translation: Mpenza? Nazali komona ete ville ezali malamu—ozali na kotambola na nkenta nionso olingi na mokɔlɔ mwa ye mwa.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That's true, but the constant noise and crowded streets drain me. I want a more peaceful environment.
dialogue.translation: Ezali solo, kasi mboso ya ntango na mbɛlɛ ya mikɔt ya mibɛlɛ ezali kopesa ngá mibɛlɛ. Nalingi eloko mbotama malamu.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I understand. However, rural areas often lack basic facilities like hospitals or good schools.
dialogue.translation: Nazali kosepela. Kasi, bato ya mboka miboso bazali na mikakatano oyo ezali na ntina, lokola lopitalo to likolo mibɛlɛ.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That's a fair point. But with remote work, I don't depend on the city for my job anymore.
dialogue.translation: Ezali mɛtɛ mwa. Kasi na lisalisi ya mosala ya ndenge, nazali kɔtɔla te na ville mpo na mosala náyangó.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: What about social life and career opportunity? You might feel isolated after a while, though.
dialogue.translation: Ndenge nini mpo na bomoi ya kati ya bato na bosangani ya mosala? Ozali kosɛka kobundama simá mokɔlɔ mwa ye mwa, kasi.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I've considered that. But the cost of housing in the city is insane — I can't afford a decent place anymore.
dialogue.translation: Nazali kokɔmba yango. Kasi, likambo ya kopesa likolo na ville ezali mɛtɛ mpenza—nazali kosala te ndako mwa malamu.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: You're right, it's a real trade-off. Perhaps a small town outside the city could give you the best of both worlds.
dialogue.translation: Ozali na solo, ezali elongo mpenza. Mbala mosika mokɔlɔ mwa ye mwa na ndenge ya ville ekoki kopesa yango malamu mpo na mikakatano mibɛlɛ.

dialogue.text: I think the main issue with the new policy is that it's too expensive for small businesses.

dialogue.text: Well, I still think it's a risky move. The economic impact is likely to be severe, especially for rural areas.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: And I believe it's a necessary risk. If we don't act, future generations will face a much harder problem.

vocabulary.note: Ezali na kozwa mpo na kozonga mpe na kosala ya motó ya nkombo oyo.
Kobimisa ete kuna oyo ekomí mpe kobunga moto ná nkombo oyo.
Na mokolo oyo, esengi 'kobundisa' (to seem) to 'kobundisa' (to show up).
Kobundisa na mbongo oyo to na ndenge moko ya kosala.
Oyo ezali kozala te to ezali mpenza kopesa.
Kobundisa kozala na nkombo oyo (mbongo, mbongo, mpe moko).
Oyo ezali kopesa biloko ya mawa to mbongo ya mawa.
Ekoma na kozala na kozala na kozala.
Ezali na kozala mpo na kosala mbongo (bastante) to mpo na kozala na mbongo (más bien).
Ekoma na kozala na kozala na kozala na kozala.
Na nsuka ya mbala moko, esengi 'kasi' to 'kasi'. (Nota: azweli te na kozala na mbongo oyo).
Ekoma na kozala na kozala mpo na kozala na kozala.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I think humor has a huge impact on communication, but its success depends on the degree of trust between people.
dialogue.translation: Nakoki humor ezali na eloko ya mawa mpo na kozala, kasi kozala na yango ezali na kozala na grado ya botosi na baye bazali.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Absolutely. If you don't know someone well, you should avoid jokes that could be misinterpreted.
dialogue.translation: Mpenza. Soki oyebi moto te, ezala na kozala na kozala na kozala oyo ekomí na kozala na ntina.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Exactly. A joke might appear funny to you, but it can seem offensive to the other person.
dialogue.translation: Mpenza. Mbala moko ekomí na kozala na kozala, kasi ekomí na kozala na moto moko.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: So, how do you approach humor at work, then? I find that a light joke can make the atmosphere more positive.
dialogue.translation: Eh, olingi humor na mokolo oyo? Nakoki mbala moko ekomí na kozala na mbongo ya mawa.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I try to use it, but the immediate reaction is not always good. Sometimes people just stare at you.
dialogue.translation: Nakoki kozala na yango, kasi mbala moko bazali na kozala te. Mbala moko bazali na kozala te.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Right. I think the key is to maintain a balance. Don't force it, and read the room first.
dialogue.translation: Mpenza. Nakoki mbala moko ezali na kozala na kozala. Kozala te, mpe kozala na mokolo oyo.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: True. If you do it too often, your colleagues will likely stop taking you seriously, though.
dialogue.translation: Mpenza. Soki ozali na kozala mpenza, bakonzi na yo bakomí na kozala yo, kasi.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, humor is rather powerful. It goes beyond simple laughter. It builds bonds, but unless you are careful, it can also break them.
dialogue.translation: Eh, humor ezali mpenza. Ezali na kozala na kozala. Ezali na kozala, kasi soki ozali na kozala te, ezali na kozala mpe.

key_phrases.translation: kozala na mokolo oyo, kozala na mbongo

scenario: Presenting a research finding
frequency_note: words ranked ~1500–3000 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Ezali na kosalela epai ya kozonga ete mabunga ezali ya motoya to ezali na ndakisa ya bolingo.
Na lingala ya akademikí, ezali kokambama na ntalo ya biloko.
Verbe ya ntalo, na kosala na -yze (na ortograafi ya ameriká).
Na botosi, groupe ya bato to biloko oyo basali na yango botosi.
Esalemi na 'to': similar to.
Esalemi na 'to' to 'with'.
Na bilako: mabunga.
Na siens, elongo ya koyeba eloko na mikolo to bisika.
Mbongo ya ndakisa ya kozonga to kozala na mbongo.
Adverbe ya mbongo, esalemi na verbe.
Esalemi na 'to': according to.
Esalemi na kosala ya kozonga to kozala na mbongo.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I've finished analyzing the data from our latest survey. Do you want to see the results?
dialogue.translation: Nakomi kobatela mbongo na botosi ya zomi. Oyebi kozonga mabunga?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, please! Did you compare the responses from the two different age groups?
dialogue.translation: Eh, ndenge nini! Oyebi kozonga biloko ya mibɛlɛ ya mibɛlɛ ya mibɛlɛ?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Of course. According to the initial figures, the younger group shows a significant increase in usage.
dialogue.translation: Ya soló. Na ntina ya mbongo ya zomi, groupe ya bankoko ezali na kozonga ya motoya na kozala na mbongo.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That's interesting. Did you observe any other notable patterns in that sample?
dialogue.translation: Ezali ya motoya. Oyebi kozala na eloko ya mbongo ya mbongo na mokolo oyo?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yes, we saw a clear trend: the older group's numbers remained stable, although they started from a higher point.
dialogue.translation: Eh, tozali na mbongo ya mbongo: groupe ya bankoko ezali na mbongo, kasi basali na mbongo ya mbongo.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: So the findings are quite similar to last year's study, but with a sharper contrast in the younger demographic.
dialogue.translation: Mbala moko, mabunga ezali mibɛlɛ na botosi ya zomi, kasi na kozonga ya motoya na bankoko.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Exactly. This clearly demonstrates that our new approach is working as intended.
dialogue.translation: Malamu. Ezali kozala na eloko ya mbongo ete mbongo ezali na kozala na mbongo.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Excellent. Let's prepare the final report and present these findings to the team tomorrow.
dialogue.translation: Malamu. Tokosala rapport ya zomi na kozonga mabunga na equipe ya zomi.

scenario: Discussing inequality and social mobility
frequency_note: words ranked ~1500–3000 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Ezali kobela oyo esili na mokolo mwa moko to na biloko ya komona.
Esika to esengo kati na biloko mibili, awa kati na baye bazali na mbongo mpenza mpe baye bazali na ntalo.
Likambo oyo esili malamu mpo na kosala noko moko.
Mokolo to bandimi ya motu ya ndako to ya soki.
Ekɔmɔlisa esengo; esalemi na nkombo ya oyo ezali to na gerundio.
Motsi oyo ekɔmɔlisa likambo oyo esili na ntina.
Motsi oyo ekɔmɔlisa esengo.
Koyeba epai ya noko moko mpo na koyeba yango malamu.
Kobundisa mingi mpo na kosala noko moko.
Kobɔka to koyoka epai ya ndenge mosusu.
Ezali na bokasi na ndako.
Biloko mingi ya malamu to mbongo mingi.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I've been reading about the income gap in our country, and it's shocking how wide it has become.
dialogue.translation: Nazali koyoka epai ya esengo ya kobela na mokolo na biso, mpe ezali na eloko ya kozonga motoya oyo ezali na esika ya kozala na esika ya kozala.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, but the real problem is the lack of opportunity for those from a poor background to improve their situation.
dialogue.translation: Eh, kasi likambo ya solo ezali esengo ya esika mpo na baye bazali na mokolo mwa moke mpo na koyeba epai ya ndenge mosusu ya kozala na bango.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Despite all the talk about equal rights, many people still struggle to get a decent job.
dialogue.translation: Na esika ya kozala na esika ya kozala, baye mingi bazali kozala mpo na kosala eloko ya malamu.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Therefore, social mobility is almost impossible for them; they remain stuck in the same class.
dialogue.translation: Kasi, kozala na mokolo ezali na esika ya kozala mpo na bango; bazali kozala na esika moko.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: However, I know a few cases where people managed to rise despite their humble beginnings.
dialogue.translation: Kasi, nazali koyoka epai ya biloko mibili oyo baye bazali na esika ya kozala na esika ya kozala.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: But those are rare exceptions; the wealth is concentrated in a few hands, and that's the core issue.
dialogue.translation: Kasi biloko yango ezali na esika ya kozala; mbongo ezali na esika ya kozala na mikolo ya moke, mpe yango ezali likambo ya solo.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: So, what can we do to change this? Maybe better education is the answer.
dialogue.translation: Kasi, nini tozali kosala mpo na koyeba epai ya yango? Boye kozala na eloko ya malamu ezali likambo ya solo.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Education helps, but we also need policies that directly address the gap, otherwise nothing will really change.
dialogue.translation: Kozala na eloko ya malamu ekɔmɔlisa, kasi tozali na bosɔtɔ oyo ekɔmɔlisa esengo, kasi oyo ezali na esika ya kozala, ezali na esika ya kozala.

scenario: Talking about leadership styles
frequency_note: words ranked ~1500–3000 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Ezali na kozonga moke toli bosangani toli projé.
Nzela ya kosala yango mpo na ndenge moko.
Komona lisusu oyo esengeli kosala.
Kokota to kolanda mosala na ye moko.
Kati na bangonga mibale.
Bato oyo bazali kosala mosala kati na bango.
Kobimisa to kolanda groupe na bato.
Bokasi to ndimbola ya kotanga bangonga.
Oyo akoki kobongwana na makambo oyo ezali kobongana.
Ezali na likambo moko te, ezali na ndenge moko te.
Bokasi ya kosala yango to kozela yango.
Oyo esali oyo tolingaki yango.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I think the best way to manage a project is to be flexible with your team.
dialogue.translation: Nazali komona ete ndenge mpenza ya kozonga projé ezali kozala na bosangani na bango.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: But if you're too flexible, people may not take their responsibility seriously.
dialogue.translation: Kasi soki ozali na bosangani mingi, bato basengeli kozela bosala na bango na bosembo.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I prefer to lead by supporting others rather than giving strict orders.
dialogue.translation: Nazali kolinga kolanda bato na kokota bango mpo na kozela bango bosala mike na kozela bango bosala mike.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: In my experience, a leader must have authority and make decisions quickly.
dialogue.translation: Na yango nazali na yango, mokolo moko mpenza akoki kozela bokasi na kotanga bangonga na bosembo.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yes, but the most effective leaders direct without being authoritarian.
dialogue.translation: Eh, kasi oyo akoki kozela bango na bosembo te.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Maybe you're right. A strict style can work, but it may not be the best for every team.
dialogue.translation: Mbala mosusu ozali na bosembo. Bosala na ndenge moko akoki kosala, kasi ezali mpenza mpo na bosangani nionso te.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Exactly. So, how do you usually manage conflict within your team?
dialogue.translation: Eh. Eh, ozali kozonga nini na bosangani na yo?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I try to support each person and give them more responsibility when they're ready.
dialogue.translation: Nazali kosala mpo na kokota moto na moto na kozela bango bosala mingi soki bazali na yango.
